title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: - Added three RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples; updated docs site navigation and examples index; minor copy and screenshot fixes.
description: Motivation: provide curated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and concrete tool-calling quickstarts so developers can onboard faster and run safe experiments. This PR adds three opinionated agent templates (email-assistant, qa-bot, and knowledge-router), three corresponding quickstarts demonstrating tool calling and structured output, and updates to the docs site examples index and side-nav. What changed (high level): - New examples/agents: rag-email-assistant, rag-qa-bot, rag-knowledge-router (each contains a README, config, and minimal test prompts). - Docs: new quickstart pages under docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-*.md with step-by-step instructions, expected outputs, and screenshots. - Docs site: added top-level "Agents & RAG" category to the examples index, updated side navigation entries, and added redirects for older quickstart URLs. - Small SDK doc snippets: inserted TypeScript and Python usage examples for tool calling and structured responses. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and example code - [x] Add quickstarts with step-through instructions and expected outputs - [x] Update docs site nav and examples index - [x] Add unit smoke tests for example scripts (node/python) - [x] CI checks passing Commits summary (high level): - feat: add RAG agent templates and example runners - docs: add quickstart pages and screenshots; update examples index and side-nav - test: add smoke tests for example runners - chore: update redirects and build config for docs site Files of interest (high level): - docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-email-assistant.md - docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-qa-bot.md - docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-knowledge-router.md - examples/agents/rag-email-assistant/README.md - examples/agents/rag-qa-bot/runner.py - examples/agents/rag-knowledge-router/index.ts - docs/_data/examples_index.yml
